title: Revision-bound TeX lecture authoring and consumer validation

supportedProfile: Executed single-file TeX semantic blocks with explicit paired narration
Native scene associations, measured paragraph vectors and standalone web reading view
Source/artifact/span-checked repairs and a verified Chalkspace export contract
excluded: Automatic proof certification or spoken equivalence checking
Automatic conversion of arbitrary unannotated lecture PDFs
Automatic recovery of handwriting stroke order or narration word timestamps

inputs: texloom-lecture wrappers, native scene sources and optional explicit TeX setup
Existing Texloom runtime and Chalkspace rendering APIs
outputs: notes.json, lesson.json, authoring-map.json and artifact manifest
Measured SVG paragraphs, native scene players and validation report
Optional Chalkspace plan, measured/estimated timing audit and video
coordinates: TeX paragraphs retain native box metrics in bp
Chalkspace placement uses board units and actual compiled beat times
Source spans use half-open Unicode code point offsets with stated precision
errorPolicy: Reject stale source or artifacts before repair
Reject incomplete or reordered block correspondence and text overflow
Keep mathematical review unresolved independently of render success

claims: Three actual TeX lecture sources compile through the public API
Native source spans, revision-bound repairs and immutable output builds are checked
No renderer code branches on lecture IDs or mathematical examples
notEstablished: Automatic generation of pedagogy or natural narration from raw notes
Sample-accurate spoken word alignment without external timestamps
